maddeler.e:
ننطلي (form VII)
# نَنْطَلِي (nanṭalī) /nan.tˤa.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَلَى (inṭalā)
# نَنْطَلِيَ (nanṭaliya) /nan.tˤa.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَلَى (inṭalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
